requirements.quote: Bits in a byte are labeled 7 through 0.
requirements.condition: When identifying bit positions within an MQTT byte.
requirements.required_behavior: Label the bit positions from 7 through 0.
requirements.why_checkable: A byte-field implementation or decoded packet representation can be inspected to verify the defined bit-position numbering.

requirements.quote: Bit number 7 is the most significant bit, the least significant bit is assigned bit number 0.
requirements.condition: When interpreting bit number 7 of an MQTT byte.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat bit number 7 as the most significant bit.
requirements.why_checkable: Known byte values can verify that masks and shifts map bit 7 to the most significant position.

requirements.quote: Bit number 7 is the most significant bit, the least significant bit is assigned bit number 0.
requirements.condition: When interpreting the least significant bit of an MQTT byte.
requirements.required_behavior: Assign the least significant bit to bit number 0.
requirements.why_checkable: Known byte values can verify that masks and shifts map bit 0 to the least significant position.

requirements.quote: Integer data values are 16 bits in big-endian order: the high order byte precedes the lower order byte.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding an MQTT integer data value.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the integer value using exactly 16 bits.
requirements.why_checkable: Serialized integer fields can be checked for an exact two-byte width.

requirements.quote: Integer data values are 16 bits in big-endian order: the high order byte precedes the lower order byte. This means that a 16-bit word is presented on the network as Most Significant Byte (MSB), followed by Least Significant Byte (LSB).
requirements.condition: When serializing an MQTT 16-bit integer data value onto the network.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the most significant byte before the least significant byte.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Serialize the least significant byte before the most significant byte.
requirements.why_checkable: A non-symmetric test value has an unambiguous expected two-byte network representation.

requirements.quote: Text fields in the Control Packets described later are encoded as UTF-8 strings.
requirements.condition: When encoding a text field in an MQTT Control Packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the field as a UTF-8 string.
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized bytes of every Control Packet text field can be decoded and validated as UTF-8.

requirements.quote: Each of these strings is prefixed with a two byte length field that gives the number of bytes in a UTF-8 encoded string itself, as illustrated in Figure 1.1 Structure of UTF-8 encoded strings below.
requirements.condition: When serializing an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.required_behavior: Prefix the encoded string with a length field that is exactly two bytes long.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet bytes can be inspected to verify the presence and exact width of the string-length prefix.

requirements.quote: Each of these strings is prefixed with a two byte length field that gives the number of bytes in a UTF-8 encoded string itself, as illustrated in Figure 1.1 Structure of UTF-8 encoded strings below.
requirements.condition: When setting the two-byte length prefix of an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the prefix value to the number of encoded bytes in the UTF-8 string itself.
requirements.why_checkable: The declared length can be compared directly with the actual number of following UTF-8 bytes, including for multibyte characters.

requirements.quote: Consequently there is a limit on the size of a string that can be passed in one of these UTF-8 encoded string components; you cannot use a string that would encode to more than 65535 bytes.
requirements.condition: When producing an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string component.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a string whose UTF-8 representation is more than 65535 bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The UTF-8 byte length can be computed and checked against the fixed upper bound before serialization.

requirements.quote: Unless stated otherwise all UTF-8 encoded strings can have any length in the range 0 to 65535 bytes.
requirements.condition: When no field-specific rule states a different constraint for an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit a string length of zero bytes as part of the inclusive 0-to-65535-byte range.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Reject a UTF-8 encoded string solely because its length is zero bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: A zero-length string can be supplied to a field without a more specific restriction and its handling can be observed.

requirements.condition: When encoding the two-byte length field of an MQTT UTF-8 string.
requirements.required_behavior: Store the most significant byte of the string length in byte 1.
requirements.why_checkable: The first prefix byte can be compared with the most significant eight bits of a test length.

requirements.condition: When encoding the two-byte length field of an MQTT UTF-8 string.
requirements.required_behavior: Store the least significant byte of the string length in byte 2.
requirements.why_checkable: The second prefix byte can be compared with the least significant eight bits of a test length.

requirements.quote: byte 3 ….	UTF-8 Encoded Character Data, if length > 0.
requirements.condition: When an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string has a length greater than zero.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the UTF-8 encoded character data beginning at byte 3, after the two length bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The offset of the first character-data byte can be checked directly in the serialized string component.

requirements.quote: The character data in a UTF-8 encoded string MUST be well-formed UTF-8 as defined by the Unicode specification [Unicode] and restated in RFC 3629 [RFC3629].
requirements.condition: When producing or accepting character data in an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.required_behavior: Ensure that the character data is well-formed UTF-8 under Unicode and RFC 3629.
requirements.why_checkable: A UTF-8 validator and malformed byte-sequence corpus can determine whether the implementation enforces well-formedness.

requirements.quote: In particular this data MUST NOT include encodings of code points between U+D800 and U+DFFF.
requirements.condition: When encoding character data in an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include an encoding of any code point from U+D800 through U+DFFF inclusive.
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary and interior surrogate code points can be encoded as test inputs and checked for rejection.

requirements.quote: If a Server or Client receives a Control Packet containing ill-formed UTF-8 it MUST close the Network Connection [MQTT-1.5.3-1].
requirements.condition: When a Server or Client receives a Control Packet containing ill-formed UTF-8.
requirements.required_behavior: Close the Network Connection on which the packet was received.
requirements.error_behavior: Terminate the Network Connection instead of continuing to process traffic on it.
requirements.why_checkable: A malformed UTF-8 packet can be injected and the connection-closure event can be observed.

requirements.quote: A UTF-8 encoded string MUST NOT include an encoding of the null character U+0000.
requirements.condition: When producing or validating an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include an encoding of the null character U+0000.
requirements.why_checkable: A string containing the UTF-8 bytes for U+0000 can be tested for rejection or prevented serialization.

requirements.quote: If a receiver (Server or Client) receives a Control Packet containing U+0000 it MUST close the Network Connection [MQTT-1.5.3-2].
requirements.condition: When a Server or Client receives a Control Packet containing U+0000 in a UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.required_behavior: Close the Network Connection on which the packet was received.
requirements.error_behavior: Terminate the Network Connection instead of continuing to process traffic on it.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet containing U+0000 can be injected and the receiver's connection-closure behavior can be observed.
